newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open down, "tankan" has little impact.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open down, "tankan" has little impact.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened lower on Wednesday, receiving little impact from the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) "tankan" survey of business sentiment, released just before the market opened, which was in line with forecasts.
Brokers said the sales in the stock market were due to technical movements.

Shortly after the market opened, the cash stock market's key Nikkei 225 average was down 159.52 points or 0.74 percent at 21,258.73. In the futures market, the key December futures contract was 70 points lower at 21,290.

The BOJ's tankan, released 10 minutes before the market opened, showed the key diffusion index for big manufacturers -- a major gauge of corporate sentiment -- was minus three for November, against minus seven in the previous survey which was released in August.
